purpose: Episode 1 (Kids): how to play Dexty, shown on the real app. Opens on the payoff, then one step at a time.

lines.text: Hi, Maya! <break time="0.6s" /> That's me, Dexter, saying YOUR name. <break time="0.5s" /> And that <break time="0.3s" /> is your very first card. <break time="0.6s" /> Want one? <break time="0.4s" /> Here's how. It takes two minutes.

Step one. <break time="0.3s" /> On a phone or a tablet, open dexty dot live. <break time="0.5s" /> Tap Kids. <break time="0.5s" /> Type the name you want me to call you. <break time="0.4s" /> Then tap Start the adventure!

Step two. <break time="0.3s" /> This is the Road of Wonders. <break time="0.4s" /> Every house hides a magic book. <break time="0.4s" /> Tap the arrows to walk, <break time="0.3s" /> and when I'm at a door, tap Go in.

Step three. <break time="0.3s" /> The book reads itself out loud. <break time="0.4s" /> See the glowing words? <break time="0.3s" /> Tap one <break time="0.3s" /> and a spark tells you a secret. <break time="0.5s" /> Turn the pages, and watch out: <break time="0.3s" /> I guess wrong sometimes. See if you can beat me.

Step four. <break time="0.3s" /> Professor Hoot asks three questions. <break time="0.4s" /> Everything he asks is in the book, <break time="0.3s" /> and if you're not sure, just try. <break time="0.4s" /> Nobody keeps score.
Step five. <break time="0.3s" /> Tap Reveal your card. <break time="0.8s" /> Whoa! <break time="0.4s" /> It's yours. Forever. <break time="0.4s" /> It lives in your backpack, up here.

And one more thing. <break time="0.3s" /> Tap Mission. <break time="0.4s" /> This one is called The Missing Shadow. <break time="0.4s" /> You move the lamp, <break time="0.3s" /> the shadow moves, <break time="0.3s" /> and when you solve it, you choose a new coat for me! <break time="0.5s" /> I'll wear it on the road.

That's it. <break time="0.3s" /> dexty dot live. <break time="0.3s" /> Free, no account, and when you're done, you just stop. The road keeps your place. <break time="0.6s" /> See you at the first house!
